other_exits: Trend-based close: if UpTrend[0] is nonzero (no new UpSignal), close short positions
Trend-based close: if DnTrend[0] is nonzero (no new DnSignal), close long positions

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM value = fixed lot size (0.1 lots), positive MM value = deposit share fraction for risk-based sizing, handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: BrakeParb has 4 buffers: buffer 0 = UpTrend, buffer 1 = DnTrend, buffer 2 = UpSignal, buffer 3 = DnSignal. Signal detection only on new bar or when SignalBar=0. On signal, opposite positions are closed first, then new positions opened. Trend buffers (non-signal) also trigger opposite-side closes. The EA uses a Recount flag to retry signal reading on CopyBuffer failure. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans act as permission gates. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous completed bar (index 1), not the current forming bar. Position open functions receive signal timestamp (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) likely for signal expiration logic within TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of BrakeParb custom indicator logic (4 buffers: UpTrend, DnTrend, UpSignal, DnSignal). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar) must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented. The conditional MM sizing (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) needs careful handling. The signal time-based entry logic (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime passed to open functions) may include signal expiration behavior that needs understanding from TradeAlgorithms.mqh source.
